dedup_scope: Canonical URL and DOI/handle/arXiv identifier checks against central ledger and accessible manifests/addenda for Batches 460, 462–468. Exact duplicates, localized/version mirrors and inaccessible candidates excluded. Global semantic deduplication incomplete.

accepted_sources.title: Motion-blurred objects and alpha mattes
accepted_sources.read_depth: Repository page and abstract read; PDF access-restricted.
accepted_sources.key_finding: Motion blur can be interpreted as apparent transparency; alpha relates to the fraction of exposure time a moving object covers a pixel.

accepted_sources.title: Spanish orientation-kernel crack detection
accepted_sources.read_depth: Repository page and all seven PDF pages read; one work counted.
accepted_sources.key_finding: ROI, Prewitt gradients, local thresholds, connected components and orientation kernels provide scale-aware line-feature detection; reported errors are task-specific.

accepted_sources.title: Ovitrap image acquisition and processing
accepted_sources.key_finding: Combines global RGB and local histogram masks, a 3x3 mode filter and disk-shaped morphological opening; aggregate and per-image errors differ.

accepted_sources.title: Interactive segmentation for faster annotation
accepted_sources.key_finding: Positive/negative clicks refine masks; NoC at a target IoU measures interaction effort; segmentation masks are not fractional alpha mattes.

accepted_sources.title: Deep-learning background removal
accepted_sources.read_depth: Full visible translated article read; no English mirror counted.
accepted_sources.key_finding: Task-specific portrait datasets and encoder-decoder architecture matter; skip connections and upsampling affect edge detail; deployment location is a product constraint.

accepted_sources.title: Matte Anything
accepted_sources.read_depth: Landing page and full HTML opened; substantial method/evaluation sections read.
accepted_sources.key_finding: Uses interactive segmentation, open-vocabulary detection and pseudo-trimap construction; results are paper-reported.

accepted_sources.title: Matting Anything (MAM)
accepted_sources.read_depth: Landing page and full HTML opened; architecture, metrics and experiments read.
accepted_sources.key_finding: SAM masks/features feed a lightweight multiscale Mask-to-Matte module; alpha is iteratively refined; multiple metrics and prompt types matter.

accepted_sources.title: VideoMaMa
accepted_sources.read_depth: Landing page and full HTML opened; abstract, introduction and architecture/training outline read.
accepted_sources.key_finding: Video diffusion priors convert coarse masks to alpha mattes and support pseudo-labeling for temporal matting; not required for static PNGs.

exclusion_details: Japanese records returned HTTP 429/timeouts; one Portuguese PDF could not be opened; exact duplicates, localized mirrors and version mirrors are listed in the local package.
